[[File:Heavy_Battle_Armor.jpg|thumb|150px]]
'''Heavy battle armor''' was virtually the heaviest [[Armor/Legends|armor]] acquirable during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. It was ideal for extreme combat situations that involved direct damage and also offered a very good level of protection in sacrifice of dexterity. Some considered it claustrophobic but that was the trade-off for safety.
